results.title: Osun poll: Turaki-led PDP endorses Oyebamiji ahead of August 15
results.description: By Sunday Oguntuyi, Osogbo Ahead of the Osun State governorship election scheduled for August 15, the Turaki-led faction of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) in the state on Sunday endorsed the candidate of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Asiwaju Munirudeen Bola Oyebamiji (AMBO). The endorsement, led by former Governor of the state, Prince Olagunsoye Oyinlola, [...]
